effectSpecs.rationale: Whole-edit grade, identical on every shot by design (contrast 1.06 / saturation 0.94 / brightness 1.0): a neutral editorial podcast look, not a per-shot filter.

segments.rationale: HOOK A — cold-open on a mid-conversation exchange lifted from 214.0s, the strongest readable image available in the first second. Signal: seg-0 full-source coverage (medium motion, conf .50); with no motionPeak or beat data in the graph the hook is built on cut rhythm plus a 0.55 punch-in rather than a claimed peak. 0.9s so it lands before a viewer can scroll.

HOOK B — the answer to hook A, cut from 305.2s so the pair reads as question/answer rather than one continuous take. Second of the two shots required inside the first 2 seconds, and it lands before any title card. punch-out reverses the punch-in direction so neighbours don't repeat; signal is the 0.9s hard cut on the source dialogue transient at 305.2s.

ESTABLISH — opens at 16.0s, near the head of seg-0, so the room and the speakers are legible after the abstract cold open. Longest phase-1 shot at 4.6s sets the podcast baseline; slow-push at 0.3 keeps a static frame alive without disturbing a speaker. Cut point 2.0s is the hook/body chapter change.

BUILD 1 — the premise of the conversation, source 58.4s. 4.2s holds the phase-1 average at 3.0s; drift-right mirrors the previous slow-push so adjacent moves differ. Signal: seg-0 medium-motion coverage, cut placed on the speaker change at 58.4s rather than in dead air.

BUILD 2 / THE EDIT'S ONE SPEED RAMP — source 104.0s, the first big statement of the reel. Ramps up to 1.12 into the line, slows to 0.88 through it, returns to 1.0 out of it: ramp in, hold through the peak, ramp out. Keyframes average exactly 1.0 (trapezoid 0.318+0.400+0.282) so the 4.2s source span still equals the 4.2s timeline slot and the sequence ends on 45.0. pitchCorrection on so the voice stays natural. breathe at 0.3 keeps the hold from dying.

PHASE-2 OPEN — chapter change at 15.0s, entered through a 0.4s dipToBlack. Shot length drops from 4.2s to 2.6s, the first measurable acceleration. Source 142.0s; the picture runs 0.4s ahead of its own audio because s4's dialogue tail L-cuts over this frame, so the speaker is never cut mid-sentence. drift-left reverses the previous drift direction.

COUNTER-SHOT — 1.7s against the previous 2.6s so phase 2 alternates long/short instead of settling into a pattern. Source 163.5s, cut on the reply. handheld at 0.35 adds energy without a zoom and settles back to base frame, so it is safe to cut out of.

BUILD 3 — the argument restated tighter, source 186.0s, 2.3s. slow-push returns after two lateral/handheld neighbours so the move vocabulary keeps rotating. Carries the 'every clip earns its place' caption from 19.6s, which ends at 21.5s, just before the 21.6s cut.

PIVOT — shortest shot of phase 2 at 1.5s, the mid-act turn at 21.6s where the conversation flips. punch-in at 0.45 plus a 0.4s tonal hit mark the pivot; the treatment is a tonal nudge, not glitch or aberration, because this is face-forward podcast footage.

EVIDENCE — 2.4s breather after the 1.5s pivot so the rhythm breathes instead of machine-gunning. Source 231.0s; hosts the '3 RULES' callout from 23.4s (0.3s after the shot begins) which clears the 25.5s cut.
LIFT — 1.8s, source 254.6s. tilt-up is the only upward move in phase 2 and it sits right before the act break, so the frame physically rises into the chapter change at 30.0s.

PHASE-2 CLOSE — longest shot of the middle act at 2.7s, the setup the payoff will answer. Source 276.0s. Its audio is trimmed to 278.4s so the picture holds 0.3s longer than its own dialogue, making room for the J-cut from s12; a 0.5s brightness dip from 29.5s pre-laps the 30.0s chapter change.

PHASE-3 ENTRY / PAYOFF TURN — the act break at 30.0s, entered on a 0.35s blur transition with a snap-zoom head at 0.5 (the strongest move since the hook) and a 0.5s grain hit. Its audio starts at 29.7s, 0.3s under the previous picture, so the new thought arrives before the frame does. Shot length halves from 2.7s to 1.3s: phase 3 is measurably denser.

RAPID EXCHANGE 1 — 1.1s, source 312.0s, cut on the reply. handheld at 0.4 keeps the back-and-forth physical; the running caption from 30.3s deliberately carries across this cut and the next so the dense run reads as one thought, not nine.
RAPID EXCHANGE 2 — 1.2s, source 324.4s. punch-in tightens as the exchange heats; alternates with the previous handheld so no two neighbours share a move.
RAPID EXCHANGE 3 — shortest shot of the reel at 1.1s, source 336.0s. drift-left opens the frame back up after two inward moves so the run does not claustrophobe.

IMPACT BEAT — 1.3s, source 347.2s, the sharpest line of the closing act. whip-shake at 0.35 snaps at the shot head and settles in ~0.25s, well before the 36.0s cut; paired with a 0.4s tonal hit at intensity 0.6, the strongest accent so far. Kept to shake plus tonal — no glitch, no aberration, no blur on a face.
TREATMENT CHANGE — 1.2s, source 358.6s, entered through a 0.3s lightLeak at 36.0s that warms the frame for the run-out. slow-push at 0.3 starts the deceleration toward the landing.

SETTLE — 1.3s, source 368.0s. tilt-down is the only downward move in the edit and it marks the deflation beat before the conclusion; hosts the 'watch to the end' caption from 36.2s which deliberately carries the 38.5s cut.
CONCLUSION — 1.7s, source 379.4s, the last short shot before the landing. Lengthening from 1.3s to 1.7s begins the brake; handheld keeps it from going static before the held outro.

LANDING — 4.8s held outro from 396.0s, longer than any shot before it (previous max 4.6s), entered on a 0.45s crossfade. pull-back eases out to the wide frame for the final beat while the tightest vignette of the edit (0.7) closes in from 40.6s and the FOLLOW card runs 40.5-43.9s, clearing the 45.0s end. Audio lifts to 0.85 so the closing line sits forward. Timeline ends exactly at 45.0 = metadata.targetDuration.

textElements.rationale: Series title card. Deliberately starts at 2.2s, after both hook shots (0.0-0.9 and 0.9-2.0), so the cold open stays clean and the hook-before-title rule holds. 0.2s after the s2 shot begins at 2.0s. y=0.16 is clear of the 9:16 top-10% UI zone and well above the face region; 2 words over 2.6s beats the 0.8s reading floor.

Episode lockup under the title, staggered 0.35s after it so the two build rather than arrive together. Different y (0.235 vs 0.16) so nothing stacks at the same position and time. Typewriter is the second distinct animation preset. Ends 5.6s, before the 6.6s cut.

First chapter marker, 0.2s after the s3 shot begins at 6.6s and clearing the 10.8s cut. 5 words over 3.2s against a 1.67s reading floor. Inherits the caption template position at y=0.74, inside the safe band and below the face.

Pull-quote of the ramped statement in s4. Starts 0.4s after the shot begins at 10.8s, exactly when the speed ramp starts slowing through the line, and ends 14.6s before the 15.0s chapter change. 6 words over 3.4s against a 2.0s floor. word-by-word is the third distinct preset and the template default.

Chapter-2 callout, 0.2s after the s5 shot begins at 15.0s, right behind the dipToBlack so it reads as the act title. Override moves it out of the caption lane to y=0.16 and drops the caption background — a callout should sit in the upper band, not the subtitle position. 2 words over 1.6s against a 0.8s floor.

Mid-phase-2 caption, 0.3s after the s7 shot begins at 19.3s. Trimmed to 1.9s so it ends at 21.5s, just before the 21.6s pivot cut, instead of spilling over it. 5 words over 1.9s against a 1.67s floor. fade is the fourth distinct preset and the quietest one, matching the shot's role.

List-setup callout, 0.3s after the s9 shot begins at 23.1s and clearing the 25.5s cut. Same accent colour as THE TURN so the two callouts read as one system. bounce is the fifth distinct preset; 2 words over 2.0s against a 0.8s floor.

textElements.content: the part nobody says out loud
textElements.rationale: Phase-3 running caption, 0.3s after the s12 shot begins at 30.0s. It deliberately carries across the 31.3s and 32.4s cuts: at 1.1-1.3s per shot no 6-word line (2.0s floor) can fit one shot, so a continuous caption is what makes the dense run read as a single thought. slide-left matches the drift direction of the run.

Retention prompt, 0.2s after the s17 shot begins at 36.0s, landing with the lightLeak treatment change. 4 words over 2.0s against a 1.33s floor; carries the 37.2s cut by design for the same reason as the phase-3 caption above. rise is the seventh distinct preset.

Outro card on the landing hold, 0.3s after the s20 shot begins at 40.2s and ending 43.9s so it clears the 45.0s timeline end rather than being chopped. y=0.20 sits above the pull-back's widening frame and out of the top-10% UI zone. zoom-blur is the eighth distinct preset and echoes the snap-zoom that opened phase 3, closing the loop.

effects.rationale: Trigger: the hook moment at frame 0. A 0.25s lift so the cold-open image reads instantly on a muted scroll. Brightness only — no aberration, glitch or blur, because this is face-forward podcast footage.

Trigger: hook B at 0.9s, the second of the two shots inside the first 2 seconds. Sharpen crisps the reaction frame; different type and lower intensity than the s0 brightness hit so consecutive hits never repeat.

Trigger: the speed-ramp peak inside s4 (the 0.88 slow-through between keyframes 0.3 and 0.7). The vignette closes in while the line lands and releases as the ramp returns to 1.0. Low-motion treatment chosen because the shot is a held face, not an action beat.
Trigger: the mid-act chapter turn at 21.6s, also the shortest shot of phase 2 (1.5s). A 0.4s tonal nudge marks the pivot without putting a filter on the speaker's face.

Trigger: the phase-2 to phase-3 chapter change at 30.0s. The dim pre-laps the blur transition so the act break is felt before it is seen. Escalates against the s0 brightness hit (0.5 to 0.55) and is nowhere near consecutive with it.

Trigger: phase-3 entry at 30.0s, on the snap-zoom head. Grain gives the dense run a different texture from phases 1-2; subtle and filmic rather than a glitch, which would be wrong on calm talking footage.

Trigger: the whip-shake impact head at 34.7s, the sharpest line of the closing act. Strongest hit of phase 3 so far (0.6) and inverted against the s8 tonal values, so type plus intensity never repeats on consecutive hits.

Trigger: the payoff/landing hold beginning at 40.2s. The tightest vignette of the edit (0.7, up from 0.5 in phase 1) closes the frame around the final thought and holds through the outro card to 44.8s. Escalation across phases is 0.4/0.5 -> 0.5/0.55/0.6 -> 0.7.

transitions.rationale: Chapter change at 15.0s, phase 1 to phase 2: the only full black dip in the reel, so the act break reads as structural rather than decorative. Paired with the L-cut that carries s4's dialogue 0.4s over the dip.
Mid-phase-2 turn at 23.1s, from the 1.5s pivot shot back out to a 2.4s breather. Soft crossfade because the energy drops; different type from the preceding dipToBlack.

Chapter change at 30.0s, phase 2 to phase 3, where shot length halves and treatment gets strongest. Blur into the snap-zoom head sells the acceleration; triggered by the same act break as the brightness pre-lap dim.
Treatment change at 36.0s, out of the whip-shake impact beat and into the settling run-out. Warm leak shifts the palette for the conclusion; not a glitch, which would be wrong on calm footage.
Into the landing at 40.2s. Longest transition of the edit so the 4.8s hold arrives gently and the pull-back can finish. Not consecutive with the earlier crossfade at 23.1s.

audioDecisions.rationale: No audio file was uploaded, so the source track is the bed. Hook A dialogue at 0.9s and lifted to 0.9 volume so the cold open lands forward.
Hook B answer, in sync with picture. Cut lands on the source dialogue transient at 305.2s, not mid-word.
Establishing dialogue bed, in sync with picture, dropped to 0.8 for the body of the reel.
Build 1 dialogue, in sync with picture; the sentence completes inside the 4.2s slot so the next cut does not interrupt it.

L-CUT: audio runs 4.6s against 4.2s of picture, so the ramped statement carries 0.4s over the dipToBlack at 15.0s and the speaker is never cut mid-sentence. Source end 108.6s extends past the picture end at 108.2s.

Phase-2 open, entered 0.4s after its picture at 15.0s so the previous line finishes over the dip. Source starts at 142.4s while the picture starts at 142.0s — the offset is the L-cut, not a sync error.
Counter-shot dialogue, in sync with picture.
Build 3 dialogue, in sync with picture.
Pivot dialogue, in sync with picture; the 1.5s slot holds one complete clause.
Evidence beat dialogue, in sync with picture.
Lift beat dialogue, in sync with picture.
Phase-2 close, trimmed to 2.4s of audio against 2.7s of picture (source end 278.4s vs picture end 278.7s) to open the J-cut into phase 3.

J-CUT: audio starts at 29.7s, 0.3s before its picture at 30.0s, so the new thought arrives under the previous frame and the act break never slices a sentence. Source lead-in 298.2s vs picture start 298.5s.
Rapid exchange 1, in sync with picture.
Rapid exchange 2, in sync with picture.
Rapid exchange 3, in sync with picture; shortest slot in the reel, cut on the reply transient.
Impact beat dialogue, in sync with picture and with the whip-shake head.
Treatment-change beat, in sync with picture across the lightLeak.
Settle beat dialogue, in sync with picture.
Conclusion dialogue, in sync with picture.
Landing bed, in sync with picture, lifted to 0.85 so the closing line sits forward under the outro card and runs the full 4.8s hold to 45.0s.

One-shot impact on the chapter change at 15.0s, timed to the dipToBlack. The only available SFX source is video-1's own track, so this is a 0.35s room-reaction transient from 288.0s laid under the dip at 0.45 — felt, not loud over dialogue.

One-shot impact on the phase-3 entry at 30.0s, timed to the blur transition and the snap-zoom head. 0.4s source transient from 350.0s at 0.5, slightly hotter than the 15.0s hit so the accents escalate.

captionTemplate.rationale: Single template for the whole reel so type reads as one system. y=0.74 sits inside the 9:16 safe band (clear of the top 10% and bottom 20% UI) and below centre frame so it never lands on a speaker's face. Elements inherit this and override only deliberately (title/callout lockups move to y=0.16-0.20, accent colour on callouts).

motionMoments.rationale: The single motion moment of the edit, bound to the PODCAST CLIPS title at 2.2s on segment 2. Placed after both hook shots so the cold open stays clean, and it is the only one — a podcast reel does not want particle bursts or glitch transitions competing with the dialogue.

metadata.rationale: 45s podcast-clips reel cut from a single 416.4s full-source segment whose only perception signals are 'medium motion, conf .50' — there is no beat grid, no motionPeak list, no facePresenceRatio and no chapter map. So the edit is authored on structure and cut rhythm rather than on fabricated signals, and every rationale cites what actually exists (source timecode, seg-0 coverage, chapter turn, hook/payoff role). Spine: two-shot cold-open hook (0.0-2.0s) -> three long phase-1 holds that establish the conversation (avg 3.0s) -> seven-shot phase-2 argument at 71% of phase-1 shot length (avg 2.14s) -> nine-shot phase-3 run at 56% (avg 1.67s) carrying the most hits and the strongest treatment -> 4.8s landing hold, longer than anything before it. One coherent grade replicated identically across all 21 shots (a treatment, not a per-shot effect), eight accent hits bound to hook/chapter/payoff triggers, one speed ramp that averages 1.0 so the timeline math stays exact, five rendered transitions at chapter and treatment changes, J/L-cut dialogue offsets so no talking head is cut mid-sentence, and the source track as the only audio bed since no audio file was uploaded.
